title: AAR Circular Letter – August 2026

## About AAR Circular Letters


Circular letter summaries are produced monthly by[Greenbrier Management Services Group](https://www.gbrx.com/services/management-services/) .


[Download GMS brochure:](https://www.gbrx.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/gms-brochure_single-pages_hires.pdf)


AAR circular letters provide information of general applicability to the railroad industry, including proposed and final rules, revisions, standards and recommended practices, and calls for comments. These summaries provide the main points of circular letters issued in the prior month, as well as important implementation deadlines.


For access to the complete circular letter, please go to[my.aar.org/circulars](https://my.aar.org/circulars) . Circular letters are a fee-based service provided by the AAR’s Transportation Technology Center Incorporated (TTCI). You may subscribe online atpublications@aar.com or call 719.584.0538.


### Implementation Circulars


**Circular Type: Implementation**


**C-14828**


**Subject:** Implementation of Editorial Revisions to MSRP Section C-I CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS, Specifications M-802


**Summary:** This circular letter notifies the industry of editorial revisions to Section C-I CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS. The revisions include updates to Specification M-802 for Manufacturer of Freight Cars, Facility Approval, and Specification M-803 for Manufacturer of Major Subassemblies, Facility Approval, with changes such as audit requirements, checklist updates, and clarifications to quality assurance manual requirements.


**Date:** 08-07-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-07-2026


**C-14831**


**Subject:** Rescinding the Circular C-14808 published on June 29, 2026; Implementation of Revisions to Figure 87 of Section 2 of the AAR Open Top Loading Rules Manual (OTLR)


**Summary:** The Open Top Loading Rules (OTLR) Committee of the Association of American Railroads (AAR) is rescinding circular C-14808, which introduced revisions to Section 2, Fig. 87 to include updated photographs and notes for loading loose scrap metal. A Technical Advisory Group (TAG) is being formed to investigate scrap loading parameters and provide guidance while minimizing disruptions in the supply chain, with participation from Class I railroads and industry experts.


**Date:** 08-12-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-12-2026


**C-14832**


**Subject:** Implementation Circular: Modifications to MSRP F, Sensors, S-6101A


**Summary:** This implementation circular announces revisions to the AAR’s Manual of Standards & Recommended Practices (MSRP) Section F – Sensors / S-6101A: Detector Validation Table / Acoustic Bearing Detectors. It includes the approval of one new fault descriptor (RS1_m) for the RailBAM hardware version 3.0 and software version 6.2 combination, with a validation date of 8/13/2026.


**Date:** 08-20-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-20-2026


**C-14833**


**Subject:** IMPLEMENTED, AAR Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices (MSRP) Section K-VI Railway Data Management and Communications, Standard S-9505.V1.0


**Summary:** S-9505.V1.0 Standardized List of ITC Default Railroad Data defines the current list of default railroad data of certain Interoperable Train Control (ITC) components for all ITC railroads. S-9505.V1.0 was adopted in 2026 and is attached to this Circular in PDF format; it will be incorporated into the next issue of the MSRP Section K-VI Railway Data Management and Communications.


**Date:** 08-27-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-27-2026


**C-14834**


**Subject:** IMPLEMENTED, AAR Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices (MSRP) Section K-VI Railway Data Management and Communications, Standard S-9505.V1.0 External Content


**Summary:** This circular implements External Content V1.0 to the Standardized List of ITC Default Railroad Data S-9505.V1.0. It includes appendices containing default railroad data and complex group tags with Railroad SCAC fields, which are electronically consumable or updated more frequently than the parent standard.


**Date:** 08-27-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-27-2026


### Call for Comment


**C-14829**


**Subject:** Solicitation of Comments for Revisions to MSRP Section C-I CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS, Specification M-947 Adhesive Backed Films for Marking Cars


**Summary:** This circular letter solicits comments for revisions to MSRP Section C-I CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS, Specification M-947 Adhesive Backed Films for Marking Cars – Performance-Based Requirements. The specification was reformatted for clarity without changing technical requirements, and warranty requirements were removed as they were deemed not appropriate for the specification.


**Date:** 08-07-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**C-14835**


**Subject:** Solicitation of Comments for Revisions to MSRP Section G-II, WHEEL AND AXLE MANUAL, Introduction, S-659, RP-631, RP-632, and R-633


**Summary:** This circular letter solicits comments for proposed revisions to sections of MSRP Section G-II, WHEEL AND AXLE MANUAL, including Introduction, S-659, RP-631, RP-632, and RP-633. The revisions cover measuring flange height of recontoured wheels, locking plate requirements, axle cleaning, water etch spalling as a failure mode, and updates to magnetic particle inspection references.


**Date:** 08-27-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**C-14836**


**Subject:** Solicitation for Comments – Revision to MSRP Section N, Specification M-951, Portable Bridge Plates for Multi-Level Auto Rack Cars


**Summary:** The Specially Equipped Freight Car Committee has proposed revisions to Specification M-951, Appendix B, Offset from Center Portable Bridge Plates – Requirements, Sections 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1. The proposed revision includes a 2-inch inboard offset bridge plate to allow loading/unloading of narrow wheelbase vehicles and updates stenciling on the bridge plate from the word “OUTSIDE” to “OFFSET”.


**Date:** 08-28-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**CPC-1448**


**Subject:** Proposed changes to MSRP Section C Part III, M-1002, Specifications for Tank Cars, Appendix B, Subcontracting


**Summary:** The Tank Car Committee has approved proposed revisions to Appendix B, Section 3.1.6.11 and 3.4.1 to clarify requirements related to subcontracting. See attachment to Circular for full text of the proposal.


**Date:** 08-25-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days


**CPC-1449**


**Subject:** Proposed changes to MSRP Section C Part III, M-1002, Specifications for Tank Cars, Appendix B, Cryogenic Facility Demonstration


**Summary:** The Tank Car Committee has approved the proposed revisions to Appendix B, sections related to Cryogenic Facility Demonstration Requirements. See attachment to Circular for full text of the proposal.


**Date:** 08-25-2026


**Comment Period:** 30 Days​​


### Notice of Circulars


**C-14830**


**Subject:** Notification of Errors in Printed Office Manual Price Matrix, April & July 2026


**Summary:** This circular notifies subscribers of errors found in the printed April 1, 2026 and July 1, 2026 Office Price Matrices related to job codes requiring ‘Component ID’ (CID) reporting. The root cause of the error and disparity between the printed file and the DAT file has been identified and will be corrected for the October 1, 2026 Office Manual Price Matrix update. Attached is a spreadsheet listing affected job codes and descriptions.


**Date:** 08-11-2026


**Effective Date:** 08-11-2026


**C-14837**


**Subject:** Informational Circular, Car Repair Facility Labor Rate – Effective October 1, 2026


**Summary:** The Car Repair Facility Labor Rate effective October 1, 2026 is $181.03, an increase of $2.40 (or 1.3%) from the labor rate estimated on July 1, 2026. Wages and weights were re-benchmarked from 2024 to 2025 statistics for the U.S. Class I Railroads, Non-Class Is and Running Repair Agents, which is the primary driver of the change.


**Date:** 08-28-2026


**Effective Date:** 10-01-2026
